name: Cain
source:
Leader of the Kanan Knight Troupe, he's an aide to [url=/c43962]Levias[/url] along with [url=/c43957]Kiefer[/url].
A smart and calm guy who doesn't like fighting. He's the guy that Teresa can rely on the most when she's in trouble.
Because of some trauma in his past he doesn't like getting close to people.
